meta.title: Question bank format - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
meta.note: The three items below are fictional and exist only to document the file format and the scoring rules. The frozen bank used in the manuscript quotes values from the case project's documents and is not distributed.

scoring_rules.normalization: lowercase; full-width to half-width for digits/latin/#+.%; thousands commas removed between digits; ~ variants unified; whitespace collapsed
scoring_rules.answerable_hit: HIT if every required_all token is present as a standalone match (numbers must not be embedded in longer numbers) AND at least min_any of required_any (when given) are present in the normalized evidence text
scoring_rules.boundary_basis: BASIS-ABSENT (correct) if the evidence contains no record/value satisfying the request_pattern; DISTRACTOR EXPOSURE counted as regex windows of +/-40 chars around each exposure_keyword that contain a digit
scoring_rules.audit: per-question matched contexts are dumped to an audit file for manual inspection; the automated numbers are reported as computed
